# Modules that are INTENTIONALLY red, one Lake target per line.
#
# The breaker/builder discipline in AGENTS.md has a phase in which a frozen
# red battery exists and its implementation does not. This file makes that
# phase explicit. It is self-checking in both directions: an undeclared
# failure fails the gate, and a declared module that is actually GREEN also
# fails the gate, so an entry cannot outlive the red phase it describes.
#
# Removing the last entry restores the original all-green control.

# Slice S2 of the split: the three algebra batteries arrived with the move
# and still open the `Effect4` namespace. Slice S3 repoints them to `Effects`
# and removes these entries.
